purpose: Select one quality-first single-Agent profile for Canonical-50 after first qualifying shared OpenCode Go capacity outside the formal denominator.

predecessor_boundary.old_artifacts: preserved read-only and excluded from v2 Case selection

candidates.rationale: quality-oriented coding model available through the OpenCode Go subscription
strong current Chat-Completions coding model available through the same OpenCode Go subscription

fixed_runtime.billing_boundary: OpenCode Go subscription only; no separately funded DeepSeek or OpenAI endpoint
fixed_runtime.max_steps_role: high safety ceiling only; not a token or quality budget
fixed_runtime.tool_execution_timeout_role: quality-preserving safety ceiling for one validation command, not a cost budget

provider_capacity_qualification.launch_capacity_gate: A separately sealed readiness record must conservatively estimate that the remaining weekly subscription quota covers every qualification call plus all 20 formal starts; a rolling-window reset alone is insufficient.
provider_capacity_qualification.use_balance_policy: must remain off; the experiment may not spill into separately charged balance
pass_rule: both candidates first pass the same two-call native-tool identity preflight
all four capacity bursts finish with the preflight-bound observed response.model identity
every qualification provider call succeeds on its first transport attempt
qualification error_codes are empty and fallback_used=false
the append-only qualification ledger proves the frozen quiet and pacing intervals
provider_capacity_qualification.failure_rule: Stop before any formal start, preserve every artifact, publish no winner, and require a new preregistration after provider recovery. Qualification is not correctness evidence and is never rerun inside v2.

execution.command_unit: exactly one Case per forge command
execution.logical_case_order: exact Golden-10 v2 manifest order within each candidate
execution.schedule: serial Case-centric ABBA image windows from the frozen command manifest; one exact evaluator image is shared by both adjacent candidate starts
execution.reason_for_serialization: remove concurrent shared-quota pressure, reuse one exact image for the adjacent candidate pair, and isolate every provider or evaluator failure to one planned start

image_window.order: persist pull intent/ownership, free-space gate, pull exact tag if absent, inspect RepoDigest/image ID/linux-amd64, run the Case candidate pair in the scheduled order, seal both official artifacts, then remove only a campaign-owned newly-pulled exact tag
image_window.preexisting_image_policy: record as preexisting and never remove
image_window.cleanup_policy: no broad prune and no deletion by glob, digest, repository, or ancestor
image_window.crash_recovery: reconcile the persisted ownership and image seal; never rerun a candidate slot once its started event exists; complete pending safe cleanup only after both slots are sealed or the campaign is terminal
image_window.prelaunch_blocker: an outcome-blind sequential pull/inspect pass must prove all ten exact tags pullable and seal their expected RepoDigest/local image ID/linux-amd64 identities; a frozen Colima /var/lib/docker free-space probe must satisfy the gate before each pull and before the first provider call

provider_infrastructure_policy.on_any_rate_limit_or_transport_error: stop remaining formal starts, preserve the partial denominator, publish no winner, and require a new preregistration

identity_policy.source: annotated tag, peeled commit, clean tracked and untracked worktree, frozen tracked file hashes, frozen .venv/bin/forge wrapper hash, dataset hashes, remote expected evaluator-image identity seal before any provider call, and matching local identity inside each Case window
identity_policy.model: requested provider/model plus the non-empty response.model identity bound by preflight and repeated on every qualification and successful formal LLM call

required_shared_primitives: quality-selection v2 campaign-input seal + evidence plan
prelaunch_blockers: weekly subscription readiness must cover all qualification calls and 20 formal starts
all frozen assets must be committed and sealed by the annotated prelaunch tag
the outcome-blind exact image seal and dynamic campaign-input seal must complete
runner_dependency.design_boundary: Quality-selection v2 owns only its qualification, pacing, Case-paired ABBA schedule, denominator, and winner policy. It must not implement a parallel formal-artifact validator, no-rerun state machine, or Docker ownership framework.

valid_candidate: 10/10 planned one-Case starts have finalized artifacts
all successful LLM calls report the exact provider/model and preflight-bound response.model identity
no provider call records a retry or transport error
candidate/prediction/official patch bytes align for every non-empty patch
official evaluator exits cleanly without structural warnings

selection_rule.primary: highest official_resolved over the fixed planned denominator of 10
tie_break_order: fewer provider or evaluator infrastructure failures
selection_rule.validity_requirement: both candidates must complete and remain protocol-valid
selection_rule.if_either_invalid: do not select a winner; repair infrastructure under a new preregistration

freeze_rule: Only the mechanically selected v2 winner may be written to showcase-quality-v1 and used for Canonical-50. Canonical-50 outcomes cannot reopen this choice.
claim_limits: Golden-10 v2 is a development set and does not measure general SWE-bench Verified performance.
This comparison chooses a current model/profile; it does not isolate Harness uplift.
Capacity probes only qualify the provider window and never enter the quality denominator.
Thinking mode omits transport temperature, so temperature=0 is recorded configuration rather than deterministic output.
The 128-step ceiling is an emergency convergence guard, not a cost or token optimization.
